_doc: THE shared agent descriptors of the fleet's agent gateway (my-ai-api, service cloud-agi-goose, WireGuard-only): the ONE list Cloud Search's chat Agent field and Cloud Code's agent picker read, so an agent is described once. Each id is the gateway's X-Agent-Mode value and its /health.modes id; capabilities say what the gateway really does for it (verified against cloud-u-containers user-ai_my-ai-api/src/code/server.mjs on 2026-10-13). Read by libs:model-catalogue AgentCatalogue (logic package, compiled by both apps).

agents.label: Claude
agents._doc: the subscription claude CLI behind claude-superset-api; an Anthropic catalogue row is passed as the CLI model

agents.label: Hermes
agents._doc: Nous Hermes Agent (native API once HERMES_API_KEY is wired, else the Hermes model behind the gateway's MCP loop); the gateway picks the model

agents.label: Goose
agents._doc: Block's goose, the gateway's default agent; GOOSE_MODEL

agents.label: DeepSeek Harness

model._doc: the gateway runs only a deepseek/... model in this mode (v4-pro, v4-flash, r1); any other pick falls back to its DEEPSEEK_MODEL, so the app sends the default instead

agents._doc: The DeepSeek harness: a gateway MODE (no service of its own, fleet null), DeepSeek's models on OpenRouter driven through the gateway's MCP tool loop (callOpenRouterAgentic). Text only: DeepSeek's chat models take no images. No native web search; web comes from the fleet MCP tools when present.
